# Initialize all constants and settings into a dictionary that is to be used throughout the project.
SET Config TO {{ }}
Variables.CreateNewList List=> TransactionData
SET TransactionNumber TO 1
SET LogLevel TO $'''%''%'''
SET LogMessage TO $'''%''%'''
SET SystemException TO $'''%''%'''
SET BusinessException TO $'''%''%'''
Excel.LaunchExcel.LaunchAndOpenUnderExistingProcess Path: PathToConfig Visible: False ReadOnly: True Instance=> ExcelConfigInstance
Excel.ReadFromExcel.ReadAllCells Instance: ExcelConfigInstance FirstLineIsHeader: True GetCellContentsMode: Excel.GetCellContentsMode.FormattedTextValues RangeValue=> ConfigData
LOOP FOREACH CurrentItem IN ConfigData
    SET Config[CurrentItem['Name']] TO CurrentItem['Value']
END
Excel.CloseExcel.Close Instance: ExcelConfigInstance
